system: You are an expert Python programmer. Write clean, idiomatic, well-commented code.
user:
Write a complete, self-contained Python module implementing a weighted directed graph using only the standard library.

The `Graph` class must support:
  - `add_edge(self, u, v, weight: float) -> None`
  - `bfs(self, start) -> list`   (BFS traversal order)
  - `dfs(self, start) -> list`   (DFS traversal order)
  - `dijkstra(self, start) -> dict`  (shortest distances from start to all nodes)
  - `shortest_path(self, start, end) -> list`  (reconstructed node path)

Include thorough docstrings and a `__main__` block that constructs a graph of at least 7 nodes (e.g. a small city road network), runs all four methods from a chosen source, and prints the results in a readable format.
